about:
Challenge Electronics, Inc. operates from East Providence, Rhode Island, where it was founded in 1991. The company is privately held; no founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in the available material.

The firm describes itself as a full-service electronics center specializing in two-way communications, marine electronics systems, GPS navigation, and satellite communications. Its team of sales and technical service specialists provides business and personal solutions, though facility size, headcount, and volume metrics are not published.

Market sectors served include two-way radio, marine electronics, and specialty electronics, with the company noting a sister company for marine products. Customers range from commercial fleets and public-safety agencies to recreational boaters seeking communications and navigation equipment.

The company emphasizes "Total Customer Satisfaction" as its guiding principle and positions itself as a leading resource for land mobile communications and marine systems since its inception.
